prerequisites: Notions in Electromagnetism: power, energy, electromagnetic waves
It is preferable to follow Energy-Thermal 1 in parallel with this module (for notions of conduction and exchange coefficient)
Calculator with Ans/Rép key, or Sequences application

learning_outcomes.text: Determine the powers transferred by radiation between several bodies

syllabus_topics: Luminance, exitance, solid angle, diffuse source
View factors – algebra, use of a catalog
Surface-to-surface model: radiosity network, in steady state
Points of interest: cavity in equilibrium with an external environment ("is the oven door hot?"), radiative shield ("thermos bottle"), ultimate greenhouse effect
bibliography: JL Battaglia, A Kusiak, C Pradere, Introduction aux transferts thermiques : cours et exercices corrigés ; Dunod, 2020.
M. F. Modest, S. Mazumder, Radiative Heat Transfer ; Academic Press, 2021.
degree: Licence Sciences pour l'Ingénieur - parcours Mécanique (L3)
